meta.description: Character LoKr (not LoRA) on Krea 2 Raw, 24GB class - new 2026-09-11. WHY: LoKr is reported to bleed identity noticeably less than LoRA on this model - put two characters in one image and they keep their own faces instead of averaging - which is the same failure the Krea 2 LoRA presets answer with Differential Output Preservation and regularization datasets. LoKr is a cheaper first try than either. Everything else is krea2_lora_low_vram unchanged: adamw8bit, linear timesteps (Krea-canonical), 1024 resolution (train at 512 or 1024, never 768 - Krea 2's own training resolutions are 256/512/1024 and 768 runs are reported to go wrong), qfloat8 + low_vram. TWO deltas from the LoRA presets. (1) network.type lokr with lokr_factor 8. The factor is CONTESTED and this is the compromise value: the ai-toolkit community leans 4, 8 is the stated middle, one published guide says 16 (at 768, which contradicts the resolution rule). Mind the direction - in LyCORIS factorization a LOWER factor means a LARGER, more expressive network (factor 4 on a 1024-dim layer gives a 256x256 block, factor 16 gives 64x64), so 4 is the heavy end and produces the multi-GB files people report. lokr_full_rank is true, which is the trainer's default and makes network.linear / linear_alpha IGNORED (config_modules.py overrides them) - they are left at 32/32 only so the UI fields show something sane. (2) LR 5e-5, half the LoRA presets' 1e-4: LoKr wants the lower rate (one wrapper rails an adaptive controller at min 5e-5 / max 1e-4 for LoKr specifically, and keeps 1e-4 for plain LoRA). Set a made-up trigger word rather than a real name. Steps 2000 is a placeholder - let the in-app advisor size them from your image count (Krea 2's target is tiered: ~45 passes/image under 30 images, 32 at 30-149, 20 above). UNVERIFIED IN THIS FORK: no measured LoKr run here, and no LoKr checkpoint has been round-tripped through ComfyUI from this trainer. Treat it as an experiment against the known-good LoRA presets, not a replacement for them.
